outcome_source: Rahmioglu 2023 endometriosis GWAS meta-analysis, European-ancestry cohorts (this study), with the Oxford and Melbourne cohorts removed for analyses using endometrial QTLs
source_location: Supplementary Table 15 (sheet Supp15.SMR-endometrium-exp), row SRP14; also Table 1 (SRP14 (eQTL endometrium, rs4770))
instruments_location: Supplementary Table 15 (NIHMS1873427-supplement-Supplementary_Materials.xlsx, sheet Supp15.SMR-endometrium-exp), row Gene = SRP14, column SNP = rs4770 (chr15:40328292 hg19); no SNP effect sizes reported
notes: SMR with cis-eQTLs from the endometrial Illumina microarray dataset (Fung et al. 2018, 229 endometrial samples). Top SNP rs4770; GWAS p 2.61x10-8; eQTL p 2.44x10-30; SMR p 5.57x10-7; HEIDI p 0.021 (printed 2.1000000000000001E-2), not marked with * so no significant heterogeneity: passes HEIDI. SMR threshold for array eQTLs 9.42x10-5 (0.05/531 probes); HEIDI threshold 0.05/m_SMR_sig. Novel finding: Yes. Paper reports SMR p-values only (no SMR beta/OR), so estimate null and direction null_or_unclear. Outcome: SMR used the European-cohort meta-analysis of this study; for endometrial QTL analyses Oxford and Melbourne cohorts were removed to keep GWAS and eQTL samples independent; case/control numbers for this reduced meta-analysis are not reported. European meta includes 23andMe (Supp Table 1, 37,182 cases), hence cohorts Rahmioglu2023_meta + 23andMe (Japanese BBJ not in the European analysis). estimate_scale set to OR by convention only; no estimate given. Headline: abstract names SRP14/BMF among genes whose expression/methylation is regulated by the risk signals, and the Discussion/closing paragraph describes these as genes with evidence for causal association with endometriosis and potential treatment targets.

outcome_source: Sapkota 2017 endometriosis GWAS meta-analysis (European; >12,000 cases; 7,899,416 SNPs)
source_location: Results, section 'Summary data-based Mendelian randomisation (SMR) analysis with GWAS meta-analysis' (text); Supplementary Figure S11 (locus plot)
instruments_location: Results text: top SNP rs61768001; Supplementary Figure S11 (SMR locus plot, three probes tagging LINC00339 / HSPC157 / HS.279842). Per-SNP values not tabulated; Table S23 lists SMR results for other traits only, not endometriosis
notes: SMR with endometrial cis-eQTLs from this study (Illumina microarray, 229 women); 453 Bonferroni-significant eQTL probes tested, SMR threshold 1.1x10-4 (0.05/453). LINC00339 was the single gene passing both SMR and HEIDI: rs61768001, pSMR = 4.82x10-7; HEIDI p-value not given (stated as passing; HEIDI threshold 0.05/m_SMR_sig). VEZT (rs7966079, pSMR 1.64x10-4) just missed the SMR threshold. Probe ID for LINC00339 not stated in the text. No SMR beta or direction reported for LINC00339: estimate null, direction null_or_unclear. Outcome: Sapkota et al. (ref 23) meta-analysis, described as '>12,000 European endometriosis cases'; number of controls not given. The local full text does not list Sapkota's datasets: outcome_cohorts deCODE + 23andMe + other is from the extractor's knowledge of Sapkota 2017 (deCODE and 23andMe co-authors; 'other' = QIMRHCS, OX, NHS2, WGHS, LEUVEN and other European case-control sets) and needs checking against Sapkota 2017; whether the summary data used included 23andMe is not stated. estimate_scale OR by convention only. Headline: title 'potential target genes for endometriosis'; abstract names LINC00339 eQTL in endometriosis risk region; Discussion calls LINC00339 'a potential causal gene' and Conclusion says there is good evidence the causal SNP influences endometriosis risk and LINC00339 expression.

Endometrial mQTLs from this study (66 European women); 4546 Bonferroni-significant DNAm probe sites tested; SMR threshold given as PSMR < 1.2x10-5 in Results and 1.10x10-5 in Methods. cg16908938 (chr2, probe bp 11,728,029); top SNP rs59129126; p_SMR 1.58E-07; p_HET (HEIDI) 1.25E-01: passes HEIDI (PHEIDI > 0.01). Only GREB1-annotated CpG in Table 5; the nearby cg07314298 (rs28689909, p_SMR 7.93E-06, p_HET 1.26E-02, also passes HEIDI) is annotated to Metazoa_SRP by the paper, so not treated as GREB1. Table 5 gives no b_SMR: estimate null, direction null_or_unclear. Blood replication (LBC-BSGS mQTLs, Table 6) is a separate dataset: GREB1 cg02584498 b_SMR 0.149038 p 1.01E-11; cg10849854 b_SMR 0.250387 p 4.40E-10; cg16908938 b_SMR 0.0779192 p 1.34E-08. Outcome: Sapkota et al. (ref 26), '~15,000 European endometriosis cases' (Methods); controls not given. outcome_cohorts deCODE + 23andMe + other is from extractor's knowledge of Sapkota 2017, not the local text; needs checking. estimate_scale OR by convention only. Headline false: abstract only says one mQTL lies in a known endometriosis risk region 'near GREB1', and neither Conclusion names GREB1 as a candidate target or causal gene (title refers generically to 'gene targets for reproductive diseases'); borderline.
